note: What the simulated world does, whichever robots play in it: measured, each number with its source. Would better robots change it? If so it belongs in robots.json. A change here starts a new evaluation environment and replays the ledger.

sources.latency_s: Field logs (tools/field_physics.py, tools/field_sessions.json): command to vision about 50 to 60 ms on 2026-10-28 (2 radios, wired vision), 80 to 88 ms on 2026-10-27 (one calibration run). The range spans both.
sources.vision: League logs, docs/sim_realism.md: robot noise 0.4 to 1 mm, heading 0.2 to 0.3 degrees. Our lab's ball at rest measures 0.3 to 0.7 mm.
sources.vanishing: League logs, docs/sim_realism.md: 0.1 to 0.9% of detections missing.
sources.ball_roll_decel: Spans our carpet, about 0.20 m/s^2 (2026-10-28, 43 kicks, tools/field_physics.py), to the league's, about 0.29 (docs/sim_realism.md) and a little above.
